ORDINANCE XXII OF 2001
BALOCHISTAN
VAGRANCY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
An
Ordinance further to amend the Balochistan
Vagrancy
Ordinance, 1958
[Gazette
of Balochistan, Extraordinary,
22nd
September. 2001]
No. Legis.2‑42/Law/79‑IV,
dated 22‑9‑2001.‑‑The following Ordinance made by the
Governor of Balochistan on 18th September, 2001 is hereby published fur general
information:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may
be called the Balochistan Vagrancy (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force on the 14th day of August,
2001.

Amendment of section 6 of W.P. Ordinance XX of 1958

2. Amendment of
section 6 of W.P. Ordinance XX of 1958.‑‑In the Balochistan
Vagrancy Ordinance, 1958, hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance in
section 6 for the words "District Magistrate" appearing twice, the
words.. "District" Officer Social Welfare and Community
Development" shall be substituted.

3. Amendment of
section 21 of W.P. Ordinance XX of 1958.‑‑In the said
Ordinance, for section 21, the following shall be substituted.
21. Any person
aggrieved by an order of a Magistrate under this Ordinance may within thirty
days of such order appeal to the Sessions Court.
